_comment: Version pointer for the Dance Pictogram app. The app reads this at startup to learn where the song catalogue lives and whether a newer build exists. Published at the repo root so it can be edited without cutting a release. Mirrored by jsDelivr for regions where raw.githubusercontent.com is blocked.

app._comment: version 0.0.0 with a null url means 'nothing published yet' - the client treats this as 'you are up to date'. Filled in by the first packaged release.
